wikidot5e:spell:animal-messenger.effectSummary: Choose a Tiny beast in range and name a location you have visited, a generally described recipient, and a spoken message of no more than 25 words. The beast travels toward that location for the duration at about 50 miles per 24 hours if it flies or 25 miles otherwise. On arrival it delivers the message in your voice only to a creature matching the description. If it does not arrive before the spell ends, the message is lost and it returns toward the casting location. A slot above 2nd adds 48 hours of duration per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:animal-shapes.effectSummary: Transform any number of willing creatures you can see within range into Large or smaller beasts of CR 4 or lower; each target may have a different form, and on later turns you can use your action to give affected creatures new forms. A target remains transformed until the spell ends, it reaches 0 hit points, or it dies. Its game statistics become the beast's except it retains alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma. It uses the beast's hit points, returns to its prior hit points on reverting, and excess damage from a 0-HP reversion carries over; it is not knocked unconscious unless that excess also reduces its normal form to 0. Its available actions are limited by the form, it cannot speak or cast spells, and its gear melds into the form and cannot be activated, wielded, or otherwise used for benefit.

wikidot5e:spell:animate-dead.effectSummary: Choose the bones or corpse of a Small or Medium humanoid in range. Bones rise as a skeleton and a corpse as a zombie. On your turns, while an undead you created this way is within 60 feet, you can use a bonus action to command one or more of them; creatures commanded together receive the same order. You can specify the next action and movement or give a general standing order. Without orders it only defends itself, and an issued order continues until completed. Control lasts 24 hours. Recasting on controlled creatures before that period ends renews control for another 24 hours over up to four of your animated undead instead of creating a new one. A slot above 3rd lets you animate or reassert control over two additional undead per slot level, each from a different corpse or pile of bones.

wikidot5e:spell:animate-objects.effectSummary: Animate up to ten nonmagical, unattended objects in range; Medium objects cost 2 targets, Large 4, Huge 8, and nothing larger than Huge qualifies. They become controlled construct creatures until the spell ends or they reach 0 HP. As a bonus action you can command any or all animated objects within 500 feet, giving the same order to those commanded together; without orders they only defend themselves, and an order persists until completed. Size statistics are: Tiny AC 18, 20 HP, +8 to hit for 1d4+4 damage, Str 4 Dex 18; Small AC 16, 25 HP, +6 for 1d8+2, Str 6 Dex 14; Medium AC 13, 40 HP, +5 for 2d6+1, Str 10 Dex 12; Large AC 10, 50 HP, +6 for 2d10+2, Str 14 Dex 10; Huge AC 10, 80 HP, +8 for 2d12+4, Str 18 Dex 6. All have Con 10, Int 3, Wis 3, Cha 1, 30-foot speed, 30-foot blindsight and blindness beyond it; an object without locomotion instead flies 30 feet and can hover, while one securely attached has speed 0. At 0 HP it reverts and excess damage carries to the original object. An attack is one melee slam against a target within 5 feet using the size-based bonus and bludgeoning damage, though the DM can make it slashing or piercing when appropriate. A slot above 5th animates two additional objects per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:antagonize.effectSummary: One creature in range makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 4d4 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature you choose and can see. If that attack cannot be made, including because no target is in reach or its reaction is unavailable, it instead has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn. On a successful save it takes half the psychic damage and no other effect. A slot above 3rd adds 1d4 damage per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:antagonize-ua.effectSummary: One creature in range makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 4d4 psychic damage and, if its reaction is available, must immediately use that reaction to make a melee attack against another creature you choose and can see. If no other creature is within range, the target instead has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn. A slot above 3rd adds 1d4 damage per slot level.

wikidot5e:spell:antilife-shell.effectSummary: A 10-foot-radius barrier stays centered on and moves with you. It excludes creatures other than undead and constructs: affected creatures cannot pass or reach through the barrier, though they can cast spells and make attacks through it with ranged or reach weapons. If your movement would force an affected creature to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

wikidot5e:spell:antimagic-field.effectSummary: A 10-foot-radius antimagic sphere moves with you. Except for magic created by artifacts or deities, spells and magical effects are suppressed inside it and cannot extend into it; a spell slot spent on a suppressed casting is still consumed, and suppression time still counts against an effect's duration. A spell or magical effect targeting a creature or object in the sphere has no effect on that target, and overlapping magical areas are suppressed only where they overlap the sphere. Existing magic on creatures or objects is suppressed while inside. Magic-item properties and powers are suppressed; a magic weapon or ammunition used from or against the sphere is nonmagical while subject to it, but regains its magic once fully outside. Teleportation and planar travel cannot start or end there, and portals or extradimensional openings temporarily close while inside. Creatures or objects summoned or created by magic temporarily vanish in the sphere and reappear when their occupied space is no longer within it. Dispel magic and similar effects do not affect the sphere, and overlapping antimagic fields do not cancel one another.

wikidot5e:spell:antipathy-sympathy.effectSummary: Target a Huge or smaller creature or object, or an area no larger than a 200-foot cube, then designate a kind of intelligent creature and choose antipathy or sympathy for 10 days. Antipathy: a designated creature that sees the target or comes within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened while it can see the target or remains within 60 feet; while frightened it must spend movement reaching the nearest safe place from which it cannot see the target. The fear ends once it is over 60 feet away and cannot see the target, but can trigger again if it sees or approaches it again. Sympathy: a designated creature that sees the target or comes within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or must spend movement each turn entering the area or moving within reach, after which it cannot willingly move away; if the target harms it, it can make a Wisdom save to end the effect. For either mode, an affected creature that ends its turn both unable to see the target and outside 60 feet makes a Wisdom save to end the effect, and it also gets another save every 24 hours. A creature that succeeds on a save against the effect is immune to it for 1 minute.

wikidot5e:spell:arcane-eye.effectSummary: Create an invisible hovering magical eye within range and mentally receive its visual information. It has normal vision plus darkvision to 30 feet and can look in every direction. As an action, move it up to 30 feet in any direction. It can travel any distance from you but cannot enter another plane; solid barriers block it, while openings at least 1 inch across allow it through.
